scientific_integrity: The universal proof is analytic; exact integer checks in dimensions 2 through 7 are supplementary. No independent verification or bibliographic certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact second moments and signed mean only; the first unsigned moment and full law are not evaluated. Possible prior equivalent results under random stochastic-matrix terminology remain to be checked independently.
title: An \(e^2\) second-moment gap for facet-stratified random simplices
